verdict.rationale: Unleash's own docs describe a first-party MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags, and a probe confirms it is documented at the official integrate/mcp page. That covers the core of connecting an agent through an official MCP server. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools and setup or auth flow, any statement on hosted versus local transport, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp
